messages:
alex_ae: Quick escalation 1: ZenithHealth POC needs cert-based auth for outbound traffic. Their firewall team refused pure IP allowlisting. Can Dedicated endpoints accept client certs, or what's the fastest workaround for a 1-week evaluation?

kevin_sales: They're under procurement constraints12: no new customer-managed proxies. Want as little config as possible on their side.

taylor_se: TL;DR: Dedicated usually gives stable egress IPs. We don't expose mTLS client auth as a standard option on hosted/dedicated control-plane endpoints. Options: (A) Reserve static NAT IP(s) for the Dedicated pool (fastest), (B) Private/VPC so traffic terminates in their network (longer lead), or (C) temporary client-cert pinning at our gateway for the POC (requires security exception + manual infra work).

zenith-netops: Security insists on client certs + IP allowlist for defense-in-depth. They won't sign off on only IPs.

jo_infra: We can allocate two /32 NAT IPs for a Dedicated pool quickly. If customer needs cert pinning, infra can configure a pinned client-cert fingerprint on the TLS listener, but this is manual and requires security-approved waiver.

pat_security: For a short POC, we can permit a self-signed or customer-issued cert to be pinned. Requirements: max 7-day TTL, CSR recommended from customer, documented revocation steps, signed exception (SEC-POC-xx). We'll log auth successes to the audit trail and provide a signed event summary.

alex_ae: Can we give Zenith a concise allowlist snippet and a curl example that exercises client cert auth if we enable it? They asked for exact copy-paste items for their firewall and SIEM teams.

jo_infra: Paste this to them:

```
# ZenithHealth - Redwood Dedicated POC allowlist
203.0.113.10/32  # nat egress ip primary
203.0.113.11/32  # nat egress ip secondary
# destination: dedicated-zenith.pool.redwood.ai (443)
```

and this curl test (client cert flow):

```
curl -v --cacert redwood-ca.pem \
  --cert zenith-client.pem --key zenith-client.key \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <DEDICATED-API-KEY>" \
  https://dedicated-zenith.pool.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

pat_security: Checklist for cert-pinned POC: 1) Customer generates CSR or requests template; 2) Redwood issues short-lived cert (<=7 days) or accepts customer cert fingerprint; 3) Infra pins fingerprint and enables TLS auth check; 4) Run tests; 5) Revoke cert and remove pin at POC end. I'll draft waiver and revocation playbook.

taylor_se: If they can't produce a CSR quickly, we can issue a customer-specific cert but that's lower-preference. Always recommend customer-managed CSR for audit reasons.

kevin_sales: Zenith asked about rotation mid-POC and logs: they want evidence of TLS client auth. Can we provide that?

pat_security: We can provide audit entries showing client auth success/failure events for the POC window and a signed statement. Not raw connection logs for privacy reasons.

jo_infra: Action items: INF ticket to reserve NAT IPs (I'll create INF-4972); Security to create SEC-POC waiver; Sales to confirm CSR vs Redwood-issued cert with Zenith. I'll ping once IPs are reserved.

deploy-bot: [ticket] INF-4972 created by jo_infra - reserved nat 203.0.113.10, 203.0.113.11

alex_ae: Scheduling a quick call with Zenith sec team 2025-10-05 09:30 PT to finalize. I'll include the allowlist and curl example. Thanks all.
